skills.name: Kick (腿踢)
skills.description:
Nezuko attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK. If the target has a shield, she deals an additional 100% of damage to the shield.
While in Demon Form, this skill changes to Flying Kick. ;Demon Form (鬼化) :'''General, Mark''': Replaces Kick with Flying Kick. At the end of every enemies' turn, Nezuko attacks the enemy at the top of the move bar with Flying Kick. :''(Dark red flames will surround Nezuko.)''

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 100%, while inflicted with Sleep she recovers 10% of her max HP at the end of every turn (regardless of enemies and allies) and removes Sleep at the start of her turn.

skills.name: Flying Kick (拳打腿踢)
skills.description: Nezuko attacks a single target twice with each hit dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK. If the target has a shield, she deals an additional 100% of damage to the shield.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 100%, while inflicted with Sleep she recovers 10% of her max HP at the end of every turn (regardless of enemies and allies) and removes Sleep at the start of her turn.

skills.name: Blood Demon Art: Exploding Blood (血鬼術・爆血)
skills.description: Nezuko sacrifices 20% of her current HP to increase a selected ally's their move bar by 50%. If the selected ally is Tanjiro, he will be granted a new turn.

upgrades.text: Removes or dispels a control effect from the selected ally.
Increases Crit DMG for the selected ally by 50%.

skills.name: Demon Form (鬼化)
skills.description:
Nezuko enter Demon Form, lasts for 2 turns. When she leaves that form, she becomes inflicted with Sleep for 1 turn.
This can only be used if Nezuko is not in Demon Form. ;Demon Form (鬼化) :'''General, Mark''': Replaces Kick with Flying Kick. At the end of every enemies' turn, Nezuko attacks the enemy at the top of the move bar with Flying Kick. :''(Dark red flames will surround Nezuko.)''

upgrades.text: While in Demon Form, Crit DMG is increased by 100%.
While in Demon Form, Crit RES is increased by 100%.
While in Demon Form and inflicted with a control effect, at the end of an enemy's turn 1 control effect will be removed or dispelled from her and she will not attack with Flying Kick.
When Demon Form is removed, the move bar for all enemies attacked by Nezuko will be decreased by 40%.
